tasks.label: Start Personal Research API
tasks.command: $env:PYTHONPATH='src'; $env:APP_ENV='development'; $env:TRADING_MODE='paper'; $env:ENABLE_LIVE_TRADING='false'; $env:PERSONAL_RESEARCH='true'; $env:INSTRUMENT_BOOTSTRAP='development'; $env:MARKETS='IN'; $env:BASE_CURRENCY='INR'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'secrets\twelvedata_api_key.txt')) { throw 'Twelve Data India research requires secrets\twelvedata_api_key.txt; no provider fallback is configured.' }; $env:DATA_PROVIDER='twelvedata'; $env:DATA_PROVIDER_IN='twelvedata'; $env:TWELVEDATA_API_KEY_FILE='secrets\twelvedata_api_key.txt'; $env:TWELVEDATA_API_KEY_FILE_IN='secrets\twelvedata_api_key.txt'; if (Test-Path Env:TWELVEDATA_API_KEY) { Remove-Item Env:TWELVEDATA_API_KEY }; if (Test-Path Env:TWELVEDATA_API_KEY_IN) { Remove-Item Env:TWELVEDATA_API_KEY_IN }; if (-not $env:TWELVEDATA_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE) { $env:TWELVEDATA_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE='8' }; if (-not $env:TWELVEDATA_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE_IN) { $env:TWELVEDATA_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE_IN='8' }; $env:DATABASE_URL='sqlite:///outputs/paper_india.db'; $env:ENTRY_WINDOW_START='09:45'; $env:ENTRY_WINDOW_END='15:00'; $env:MAX_POSITION_QUANTITY='20'; $env:MAX_ORDER_NOTIONAL='25000'; $env:API_TOKEN_FILE='secrets\local_dashboard.secret'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'secrets\ai_api_key.txt') { $env:AI_BASE_URL='https://api.openai.com/v1'; $env:AI_MODEL='gpt-4.1-mini'; $env:AI_API_KEY_FILE='secrets\ai_api_key.txt'; $env:AI_TIMEOUT_SECONDS='20'; if (Test-Path Env:AI_API_KEY) { Remove-Item Env:AI_API_KEY } }; & '${command:python.interpreterPath}' -m uvicorn stockmarket.api.bootstrap:create_app_from_env --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001 --workers 1

tasks.label: Start US Paper Auto-Loop API
tasks.command: $env:PYTHONPATH='src'; $env:APP_ENV='development'; $env:TRADING_MODE='paper'; $env:ENABLE_LIVE_TRADING='false'; $env:PERSONAL_RESEARCH='false'; $env:INSTRUMENT_BOOTSTRAP='none'; $env:INSTRUMENT_MASTER_FILE='config\instruments_us_paper.json'; $env:MARKETS='US'; $env:BASE_CURRENCY='USD'; $env:DATA_PROVIDER='twelvedata'; $env:TWELVEDATA_API_KEY_FILE='secrets\twelvedata_api_key.txt'; if (-not $env:TWELVEDATA_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE) { $env:TWELVEDATA_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE='8' }; $env:DATABASE_URL='sqlite:///outputs/paper_auto_us.db'; $env:ENTRY_WINDOW_START='09:45'; $env:ENTRY_WINDOW_END='15:30'; $env:MAX_POSITION_QUANTITY='20'; $env:MAX_ORDER_NOTIONAL='25000'; $env:KILL_SWITCH_AUTO='true'; $env:API_TOKEN_FILE='secrets\local_dashboard.secret'; $env:AI_BASE_URL='https://api.openai.com/v1'; $env:AI_MODEL='gpt-4.1-mini'; $env:AI_API_KEY_FILE='secrets\ai_api_key.txt'; $env:AI_TIMEOUT_SECONDS='20'; if (Test-Path Env:AI_API_KEY) { Remove-Item Env:AI_API_KEY }; $env:PAPER_AUTO_LOOP='true'; $env:PAPER_AUTO_LOOP_MARKET='US'; $env:PAPER_AUTO_LOOP_INTERVAL_MINUTES='10'; $env:PAPER_EOD_FLATTEN_MINUTES='10'; $env:PAPER_DISCOVERY_ENABLED='true'; $env:PAPER_DISCOVERY_HOLD_MINUTES='30'; $env:AUTOMATIC_EVIDENCE_MAX_AGE_DAYS='90'; $env:PAPER_EXPLORATORY_AUTO_ENTRIES='true'; & '${command:python.interpreterPath}' -m uvicorn stockmarket.api.bootstrap:create_app_from_env --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --workers 1
